skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Conduct independent research, including data collection, analysis, and synthesis of economic and social issues related to human resource economics.
Analyze and interpret economic phenomena and issues related to human resource economics at organizational, industry, and local levels.
Apply economic theories to evaluate and forecast changes in the labor market under different contexts.
Develop listening, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to resolve issues in practical settings.
Demonstrate the ability to take initiative, self-study, and propose solutions based on practical analysis.
Plan, organize, and execute tasks effectively, both individually and in teams.
Understand and apply economic theories to analyze and predict labor market changes.
Manage human resources effectively, including recruitment, training, and performance evaluation.
Write comprehensive reports and graduation theses based on research findings.
Analyze data to draw conclusions and propose solutions to practical problems.
